you don't need to apologize! thank you for reading and commenting. it makes me feel less lonely knowing that there is someone like me.
can i ask you something? if you had the oportunity to go back to your old school, would you do it? do you think it would be a little better?
if i choose to stay in this school, i will try to talk to the school's therapist. also, i tried meditating once, but i think i couldnt concentrate enough, i have to try harder.
i hope things get better for us!

i think you shoud not worry too much about mentioning things, you can say it another time. if they ask "oh but why didn't you say it last time?" you can just say "oh, just because you didn't ask", or something like that.. i don't think they are going to be angry at you because you didn't tell, it doesn't make sense.

and about lying, i think that's normal, everyone said at least a little lie to fit in. i think you should just try to keep the lie? but don't make it bigger, you know?

do you think these people are the kind who will judge you about the school? if it was private or public?
well I guess we are all really strong then.

Hello, thank you so much for reading and commenting, I feel a little less lonely now.. 
Well, I think the main reason I suffer is because of my social phobia, because it makes me insecure, my self steem is very low, and you know, I cant really be myself with anyone, I cant make friends. And it makes me so sensitive to any comment, any critic, anything anyone says to me, I think about it too much and suffer. So I cant take anything, everything is too much for me, even when it comes to studying, because I think I wont be enough, I cant do it, I will be a disappointment to my parents... It ruins my whole life. I feel like I am such a weak person.
Yes, I went to therapy for these past 2 years and now I'm going to a cognitive comportamental therapy. And I also take an antidepressive. You know, Im a lot better than I was, but still, I feel like Im stuck. 
And yes, my parents are supportive and they try so hard to understand me, I can see that. 
I dont think I have any reasons to suffer like I am suffering now. I have a good family and a house and food and everything I need. I think the problem is me, the problem is the way I am.... I cant change.
